tsbs.title: Head gasket can leak coolant (warranty extended, CVT)
tsbs.plain_summary: On some 2023 and newer Integras with the CVT automatic, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Acura lengthened the warranty on this part. An Acura dealer checks your VIN to see if it qualifies.

coverage.term: 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

verified.method: Read the NHTSA-filed PDF (static.nhtsa.gov) via WebFetch; NHTSA byNhtsaId API was not reachable from this session; the filed PDF is a dealer notice listing Acura 26-001, 26-002 and 26-003; bulletin covers 2023-2026, site data stops at 2024

tsbs.title: Head gasket can leak coolant (warranty extended, manual)
tsbs.plain_summary: On some 2023 and newer Integras with a manual gearbox, the head gasket can stop sealing well. The engine may run hot, lose coolant or misfire. Acura lengthened the warranty on this part. An Acura dealer checks your VIN to see if it qualifies.

coverage.term: 10 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first

verified.method: Read the NHTSA-filed PDF (static.nhtsa.gov) via WebFetch; NHTSA byNhtsaId API was not reachable from this session; same dealer notice as acura-26-002; Acura numbers its bulletins separately from Honda
